claimLevel: DEVICE_MEASURED controls + SOURCE_DERIVED route timings; occupancy thresholds are calibrated per run

target.launcherClaim: DEVICE_MEASURED: explicit am start -W -n com.scottgames.fivenightsatfreddys/.Main returned Status ok on 2026-09-22 after a deliberate aborted attempt.

title.why: The wrapper clears TITLE_MODEL and passes FNaF 1's model explicitly. This route never calls menu.sh or accepts FNaF 2's title model.

timing.lightAfterPressClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: 10-frame click cooldown at 60 Hz is 166.7 ms; 250 ms retains an 83.3 ms margin before the next button press and before the native screenshot.
timing.flipSettleClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: mmonitorUp/mmonitorDown completes at 22.9 source frames; 22.9 / 60 s is 381.7 ms, plus a 33 ms seam margin and rounded up.
timing.cameraUpDwellClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: Foxy's attention refreshes every 100 ms while any camera is up; 250 ms gives two refresh opportunities after the flip settles.
timing.officeReadyDelayClaim: BOUND, not a readiness measurement: this only avoids pressing through the immediate Continue transition. The following off/on light calibration is the readiness gate; it refuses rather than asserting that a seven-second wait proved the office was interactive.
timing.doorRecheckClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: the door-side movement rolls are 4970/4980 ms. A 7000 ms closed interval spans one full roll plus 2.02 s slack before reopening for a fresh light read.
timing.actionBoundClaim: BOUND, not a terminal measurement: FNaF 1's sourced night length is 535000 ms. The runner stops control after 570000 ms and lets title-gated teardown wait for a banked title rather than pressing through an unknown terminal.

night1Staging.clockOrigin: The Continue HID release. This is deliberately conservative: source initialization may begin immediately after that input, so a later visual card/office observation never moves a defensive control earlier.
night1Staging.bonnieArmedClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: CLOCK hour 0 is 90000 ms and hour 1 is 89000 ms; ROWS g470 adds Bonnie +1 at 2 AM. Until then Night 1 has all four activity counters at zero, and g318's Random(20)+1 <= 0 can never move Bonnie.
night1Staging.leftCalibrationClaim: DEVICE_MEASURED on fnaf1-night1-community-loop-a-20260922T043341216Z: from first left light contact to the completed two-pair detector model was 6182 ms. The 10000 ms bound leaves 3818 ms before the 2 AM activation boundary; it is a one-time readiness calibration, not a scan loop.
night1Staging.leftScanClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: Bonnie's g318 roll period is 4970 ms. A 7000 ms clear-door interval spans one roll plus 2030 ms slack; no monitor, right pan, or right light is used in this phase.
night1Staging.rightAndCameraArmedClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED: hour 2 lasts 89000 ms after the 2 AM boundary, so g471 adds Chica and Foxy +1 at 3 AM (90000 + 89000 + 89000 = 268000 ms).
night1Staging.rightAndMonitorCalibrationClaim: DEVICE_MEASURED on fnaf1-night1-community-loop-a-20260922T043341216Z: right pan/light calibration plus the monitor up/down calibration took 12635 ms. The 18000 ms bound leaves 4000 ms before 3 AM; this is the only right/camera preparation before their sourced activation.
night1Staging.fullLoopClaim: SOURCE_DERIVED staging boundary: the full two-door/camera loop may begin only after the right/monitor preparation and before the 3 AM Chica/Foxy activation boundary.

sensing.why: The light region and occupancy bands are derived from the current run's empty, lit frames; a missing or ambiguous result never opens a door.

audio.purpose: Passive, retained evidence only. Audio does not authorize, select, or suppress any game control.

teachingOverlay.purpose: A FNaF 1-only, noninteractive teaching narration. It starts only after this route's FNaF 1 title gate has allowed Continue, is verified through its own dumpsys contract, and never supplies a visual, title, audio, or control fact.
